verdict.rationale: Ironclad's developer docs include a dedicated guide to embedding the Ironclad Signature experience for a signer in an iframe. Separate guides cover embedding a clickwrap in your own pages once a Clickwrap Workflow is published, so in-app or on-site signing and acceptance is a documented first-party capability. missing for 10: details of the embedded signature flow (setup steps, auth/session handling, customization, event callbacks), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded signing experience.
